finding: Macrosomia may act as a protective factor against early formula-milk supplementation, increasing the likelihood of EBF in the early post-partum period, but rates of exclusive breastfeeding continued to decline over the first 4 months post-partum.
mod_finding: While macrosomia was not associated with exclusive breastfeeding rates at 8 weeks or 4 months postpartum, infants born to women who gave birth to macrosomic infants were more likely to be exclusively breastfed at birth and 2 weeks postpartum.
